newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo trades flat vs mark, little activity seen.
newsitem.headline: Escudo trades flat vs mark, little activity seen.

text.p: The escudo opened flat against the mark and traders said they expected a quiet session with the currency moving within a narrow range.
The reason for the lack of movement on escudo-mark was the apathetic tone to other European crosses and the calmness of the dollar, they said.
The currency was trading at 100.85/88 to the mark against its 100.86/89 close on Thursday. Traders saw a range for the today of 100.70 and 101.00.
